Creative Vegetarian Cuisine Held Back by the Dining Experience
Jul 2026 • Solo
Fresh Thuận Nam Melons Soup ("Súp dưa tươi Thuận Nam") - The fruits were fresh and the soup wasn't overly sweet. I was also surprised that it had more depth than expected, with subtle layers of flavor instead of tasting like plain blended melon. The presentation was attractive as well. Unfortunately, I expected something more creative for the price. Instead, it felt like a dish that could be easily recreated at home. Considering the tiny portion, I can't recommend it unless you're willing to pay a premium for presentation alone.

Rolls with Lotus Stem and Lào Cai Spring Shoots (Cuốn củ sen - ngó xuân Lào Cai) - One of the highlights of this dish is its crunchy texture. Every bite feels fresh and crisp, while the rolls themselves hold together well without becoming soggy. The filling has a unique yet mild flavor. The accompanying dipping sauce is the star of the dish since it was rich and flavorful. Fortunately, it enhances the overall experience without completely overshadowing the ingredients. Presentation is another strong point since the rolls are elegantly plated. 

Pomelo Salad in Tây Bắc Passion Fruit (Gỏi bưởi chanh dây Tây Bắc) - The sweetness of the Tây Bắc passion fruit complements the citrus notes of the pomelo, creating a dressing that is neither too sweet nor too sour. The pomelo itself is the highlight of the dish. It was juicy, plump, and bursting with freshness. The vibrant colors make the dish visually appealing, which was perfect for summer.

⭐️ King Button Mushroom Stuffed with Artichoke and Vegetables (Nấm mỡ nhồi Atiso, rau củ) - This was my favorite dish of the entire meal and the one I would recommend. The king button mushroom was cooked perfectly, becoming soft and tender. Inside, the finely diced filling of the vegetables was equally soft, creating a harmonious texture throughout the dish. What elevated the dish was the seasoning. It was rich, and it brought out the natural flavors of the mushroom and vegetables without overpowering them. Every component was cooked properly. This dish stood out because of its excellent execution. 

Glazed Eggplant in Local Holy Basil Sauce, Seared King Oyster Mushrooms Wrapped in Rice Paper (Cà tím nướng om sốt hương nhu, nấm đùi gà gói bánh tráng áp chảo) - The glazed eggplant was soft and creamy. The glaze adds richness, but I was hoping for a more holy basil flavor. I didn’t like the mushroom wrapped in pan-seared rice paper. Instead of being crispy, the wrapper was quite hard, making it difficult to bite through. The contrast between the velvety eggplant and the tough wrapper felt too extreme, and the lack of crispiness made this component less enjoyable. One thing I appreciated was the fresh herbs served on the side. 

Lâm Đồng Tamarillo and Ninh Thuận Green Jujube in Crispy Wrapper, Served with Ice Cream (Bánh gói táo Ninh Thuận, cà chua thân gỗ Lâm Đồng, dùng kèm kem tươi) - This dessert was a great way to end the meal, combining creativity with well-balanced flavors and textures. The highlight of the dish was its presentation and concept. Wrapping the green jujube jam in a crispy wrapper that resembled a piece of wrapped candy was a playful and thoughtful touch. It felt original without being complicated. The filling itself was delicious, with the green jujube jam providing a pleasant sweetness. Paired with the creamy ice cream, the dessert didn’t feel heavy. The only component that didn't quite work for me was the tamarillo. I didn't think it was the best fruit to accompany the dessert, but that is just my take.

I would also like to commend the restaurant for its welcoming atmosphere and attentive staff. I really liked the restaurant's design and theme. Initially, I was planning to give this restaurant a 4/5 rating. However, I ultimately rated it 3/5 because there were many flies in the area where I was seated, and I started getting itchy on my arms. Thankfully, one of the staff members kindly brought me an insect repellent spray and even helped apply it to my arms, which I truly appreciated. Despite her excellent service, the issue with the flies significantly affected my overall experience.

Dear Mr./Ms. Karng,

Thank you for taking the time to share such a thoughtful and detailed review of your experience at Hum Garden.

We truly appreciate the care you put into describing each dish, as well as your honest reflections throughout the meal. It is encouraging to know that you enjoyed the restaurant's atmosphere and our team's hospitality, and that several dishes left a lasting impression. We are equally grateful for your thoughtful comments on the dishes that did not fully meet your expectations, as perspectives like yours help us continue learning and refining the dining experience we hope to create.

At the same time, we are sincerely sorry that the presence of flies affected your overall experience. As Hum Garden embraces an open garden setting to stay closely connected with nature, occasional insects can unfortunately be difficult to avoid entirely. That said, we fully understand that this should not come at the expense of our guests' comfort. While our team maintained preventive measures and was glad to assist you during your visit, we recognize that the inconvenience still affected your experience, and we will continue to look for ways to further improve this aspect of the garden environment.

Thank you once again for your generous and constructive feedback. We truly appreciate the opportunity to reflect, and we hope to welcome you back for an even more comfortable and memorable experience in the future.
